integrity: Mathematical conclusion is supported by a self-contained executable exact combinatorial certificate and a mathematical CW argument. Same-model scientific review only; no independent validation or certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact integral homotopy for the single open-neighborhood complex of \(T_7\)=\(L(K_7)\); no arbitrary triangular-graph family, closed-neighborhood, equivariant, or publication-priority theorem. The older unbalanced-bipartite theorem plus a relative sequence already determines the integral Betti numbers; the new statement is the nullhomotopy of all four-cell attaching maps and the resulting wedge decomposition.
title: Integral mixed-sphere homotopy of the triangular graph neighborhood complex \(\mathcal N(T_7)\)
